question: Should the repository enable this exact Developer ID and App Store Connect secret contract for production macOS releases after an end-to-end credentialed rehearsal?
rationale: The code can be reviewed from the diff, but only the repository owner can authorize use of the named signing identity and verify that the release credentials are intentionally provisioned and operational.

options.title: Validate then merge
options.body: Run a credentialed release rehearsal that completes signing, notarization, stapling, strict verification, and Gatekeeper assessment before merging.

options.title: Pause for credential setup
options.body: Keep the PR open until the Developer ID certificate and App Store Connect API credentials are provisioned and their ownership is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Validate then merge
recommendation.body: Run a credentialed release rehearsal that completes signing, notarization, stapling, strict verification, and Gatekeeper assessment before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR metadata identifies steipete as repository OWNER and as the author of the proposed personal Developer ID release contract.
